scope: Refinery structures within the exact named industrial site perimeter: native building/tank layout and characteristic process-column silhouettes. Adjacent city, airport, hospital and detached river industry excluded.

quallaSearch.notes: Started with cleared Qualla originals. Both selected NIOC images date to1970-09 in the original local metadata and record PD Iran. No external imagery required. Broad massing/material/industrial typology controls only, not a complete modern equipment survey. Uncertain sources excluded.

originalReview.notes: Both full native NIOC originals inspected: catalytic-facility street view and broad refinery overview. Original local metadata explicitly dates both to September1970 and records PD Iran; hero publication credit is Iranian Oil Industry during the Kingdom of the Pahlavi Dynasty page47. They show tall pale cylindrical process columns with multiple dark circular catwalks, narrow flue stacks, horizontal vessels, pipe racks, pale/yellow industrial halls and banks of round storage tanks.1970equipment positions are not a current inventory; native map plans must control actual site/building placement. Uncertain Nevit group portrait(public-domain basis not recorded) and unrelated museum/hospital/workers photos excluded.
